component_guidelines.cards: Border 1px border-slate-800 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-slate-700
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg buttons with explicit state transitions (hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98])
component_guidelines.progress_bars: Custom animated gradient progress bars with glow effects
component_guidelines.test_id_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='dsa-problem-status-select', data-testid='schedule-session-btn')

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI templates. Use dark glassmorphism, precise 1px borders, subtle noise/gradient glows.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown menu backgrounds.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers have clear data-testid attributes.
Do NOT center align the whole page. Keep left-aligned clean layout structure.
Use Sonner toast notifications for status updates and reminder confirmations.
